summary: Extended the planner-ceiling measurement: re-baselined on fresh master tapes and quantified how far the original eight-tape cohort inflated every lifetime-sensitive figure, showed the sampling series has an interior optimum rather than an asymptote at the requirement, and confirmed the clairvoyant ceiling is robust to the cohort.
validationPerformed: Re-ran fair depth 4 and the fair planner on 128 fresh master tapes; the fresh-tape lifetime figure agrees with two independent base-engine measurements.
Corrections were added as marked sections rather than by rewriting the superseded findings.
limitations: Recorded by the coordinator on the delegated agent's behalf; the agent had no write access to research/ and did not review this transcription.
Exploratory namespace only; does not upgrade docs/research/ or any frozen protocol.
Corrects the central quantitative claim of an earlier finding in the same namespace; the earlier text is retained and marked rather than removed.
The reported legal ceiling is an interior optimum of a sampling series, not a proven upper bound on legal play.
